# Invoicing business rules

Agreed with Accounting. Each rule has its originating ticket.

- R1 (INV-12): sequential numbering per series and year.
- R2 (INV-15): corrective invoices reference the original one.
- R3 (INV-21): VAT is rounded to 2 decimals per invoice, not per line.
- R4 (INV-30): the reduced rate (10 %) applies only to the FOOD family.
- R5 (INV-41): 3 % discount from a taxable base of 1,000 € upwards.
- R6 (INV-44): the accounting CSV uses a decimal point and no thousands separator.
